description: Ceiling for platform tooling size. Counts every .mjs file under .agents/skills/platform, tests included. When the measurement exceeds maxLoc, split validators from runtime instead of raising the number.
reviewTriggers: a release changes platform module boundaries
the remediation or measurement method changes
remediation: Split .agents/skills/platform into validators/ (read-only audits) and runtime/ (executors, runners, schedulers) before raising maxLoc.
